      have h₄₂ : (1 + Real.sin t) * (1 - Real.sin t) = 1 - (Real.sin t)^2 := by ring
      rw [h₄₂]
      have h₄₃ : 1 - (Real.sin t)^2 = (Real.cos t)^2 := by

        ring

    calc

          = ((1 + Real.sin t) * (1 - Real.sin t)) * ((1 + Real.cos t) * (1 - Real.cos t)) := by ring
      _ = (Real.cos t)^2 * (Real.sin t)^2 := by rw [h₄₁, h₄₄]

    rw [h₁₀₂] at h₉
    have h₁₀₃ : (m : ℝ) / n - Real.sqrt 10 = 9 / 4 - Real.sqrt 10 := by
